pages.text: $(l)Getting it$()$(br)Creatures with affixes drop it half the time (+10% per Looting level); bosses always do.$(br)Alchemical creations drop it 15% of the time.$(br)The wandering alchemist also sells it.
$(l)Getting it$()$(br)Smelt a gold ingot in a furnace or blast furnace fuelled by $(l)amethyst shards$().$(br2)Nine make an $(l)alchemical source block$(), and back.
$(l)Crafting$()$(br)Crafting table: string and alchemical essence, shapeless.$(br2)Eight around a book make a $(l)basic charm$().
